select
    
s.period,
s.period_start_date,
s.reporter_code,
s.partner_code,
s.flow_code,
s.cmd_code,
s.hs_version,
s.primary_value,
s.net_weight,
s.quantity,
s.ingested_at,
s.source_file,
s.checksum,
s.run_id,
s.revision
,
    c.source_name,
    coalesce(c.partner_type, 'unknown') as partner_type,
    coalesce(c.classification_status, 'needs_review') as classification_status,
    c.map_iso3,
    coalesce(c.reconciliation_role, 'unresolved') as reconciliation_role,
    h.hs_description,
    c.partner_code is not null as country_mapping_found,
    h.cmd_code is not null as hs_mapping_found,
    m.month_start_date is not null as month_mapping_found
from `trade-analytics-508604`.`trade_analytics_day08_fixture`.`stg_un_comtrade__partner_trades` s
left join `trade-analytics-508604`.`trade_analytics_day08_fixture`.`dim_countries` c on s.partner_code = c.partner_code
left join `trade-analytics-508604`.`trade_analytics_day08_fixture`.`dim_hs_codes` h
    on s.hs_version = h.hs_version and s.cmd_code = h.cmd_code
left join `trade-analytics-508604`.`trade_analytics_day08_fixture`.`dim_months` m on s.period_start_date = m.month_start_date

with mapped as (
    select s.run_id, s.period_start_date, s.cmd_code, s.hs_version,
        s.partner_code, s.primary_value, s.source_file,
        c.partner_code is null as missing_reference,
        coalesce(c.classification_status, 'needs_review') != 'verified' as classification_needs_review,
        coalesce(c.reconciliation_role, 'unresolved') = 'unresolved' as reconciliation_unresolved,
        c.map_iso3 is null as map_unavailable,
        c.classification_note, c.mapping_note
    from `trade-analytics-508604`.`trade_analytics_day08_fixture`.`stg_un_comtrade__partner_trades` s
    left join `trade-analytics-508604`.`trade_analytics_day08_fixture`.`dim_countries` c on s.partner_code = c.partner_code
), issues as (
    
    select *, 'missing_reference' as issue_type,
        'No reference for source partner_code'
         as reason
    from mapped where missing_reference
    union all
    
    select *, 'classification_needs_review' as issue_type,
        coalesce(classification_note, 'No reviewed classification') as reason
    from mapped where classification_needs_review
    union all
    
    select *, 'reconciliation_unresolved' as issue_type,
        coalesce(classification_note, 'No reviewed classification') as reason
    from mapped where reconciliation_unresolved
    union all
    
    select *, 'map_unavailable' as issue_type,
        coalesce(mapping_note, 'No verified map mapping')
         as reason
    from mapped where map_unavailable
    
    
)
select timestamp('2026-09-20T07:53:02.007397+00:00') as observed_at,
    run_id, period_start_date, cmd_code, hs_version, partner_code, issue_type,
    source_file, reason, count(*) as row_count, sum(primary_value) as primary_value_sum
from issues
group by run_id, period_start_date, cmd_code, hs_version, partner_code,
    issue_type, source_file, reason
